::: {.Rcode title="Source code"}
The full R script is available at:

-   [`R/prepare_patients.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Dialysis-facility-density-USRDS/blob/main/R/prepare_patients.R)

This R script file is itself reliant on the following files:

-   [`R/setup.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Dialysis-facility-density-USRDS/blob/main/R/setup.R)
-   [`R/functions.R`](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Dialysis-facility-density-USRDS/blob/main/R/functions.R)

The code sections below are imported directly from that script when this page is rendered.

```{r}
#| include: false

knitr::read_chunk("../R/prepare_patients.R")
```

## Loading the Medical Evidence file

`usRds` finds the file in the folder set by `set_USRDS_wd()` and applies the USRDS value labels from Appendix C of the Researcher's Guide [@usrds2024guide], so codes become their documented meanings. That is how the replication found that the coding of `DIALSET` has changed: code 1 now means home dialysis, where in the coding the original code was written for it meant hospital inpatient. The original code typed the codes and their meanings by hand. The primary cause of kidney failure (`PDIS`) is kept as the raw code because several codes share a description.

```{r}
#| label: load-medevid
#| eval: false
```

## Patient variables

Each form is numbered within its patient, and the first form is flagged. Race is grouped into the paper's five groups. How the Stata analysis merged the form's other codes is not recorded, so for this demonstration Middle Eastern counts as White and South Asian as Asian, following the 1997 OMB race standard, and Other or multiracial counts as White, the largest group. The detailed race is kept as `race_detailed`. The facility ID is `PROVUSRD` in older releases and `PROVUSRD_DIAL` in the 2024 guide.

```{r}
#| label: derive-patient-variables
#| eval: false
```

## Residence on the dialysis date

An interval join picks the residence period that contains the date of dialysis start. A patient with no such period, or with more than one, gets no residence and is excluded in the flowchart, where the count is shown.

